## 7. Baseline interpretation

The four validator warnings (3 UNREALIZED_CAPABILITY on umbrella caps SLICE/MODEL/EXTRACT + 1 MISSING_META source_artifacts) are structural: umbrella caps are aggregators containing sub-caps that carry the realizing components; they are not expected to have direct realizing behaviors. Source_artifacts meta will be populated at T0.8 when the viewer regeneration establishes the artifact publish trail.

This report is the **T0.7 baseline**. Every subsequent plan-b commit must not regress `G-INTENT` or `G-DELIVERY` on non-actor entities. `G-OPEN-Q` is expected to grow as gap enumeration lands in Phase B'-0b.
